title: Point density contours
intent: Reveal the shape and overlap of dense two-dimensional point clusters.

ai.create: Create six filled density contours over two typed point clusters. Plot should use density; TanStack should map points with the supplied scales and inject d3-contour's contourDensity through a local custom mark.
ai.maintain: Preserve the pixel bandwidth, threshold count, scale domains, and responsive estimator size. Do not replace the battle-tested density estimator with custom kernel math.
